style_name: Digital surrealist vintage newspaper conference poster
style_summary: A premium 9:16 vertical poster with an extremely rigid, non-floating Swiss grid. Typography is locked to precise vertical and horizontal axes to ensure pixel-perfect consistency across a multi-page carousel. Features distressed hot-metal typesetting Chinese text in the top 45% and a surrealist collage focal subject strictly anchored in the bottom 45%.

composition.global_margins: Mandatory 10% empty padding on all four edges (Top, Bottom, Left, Right). No elements may bleed into this margin.

spatial_anchors.vertical_axis: An invisible rigid line at exactly 10% from the left edge. ALL text MUST be flush-left aligned perfectly to this axis.
spatial_anchors.headline_block_y: Locked at exactly 10% from the top edge.
spatial_anchors.body_text_block_y: Locked at exactly 22% from the top edge.
spatial_anchors.focal_subject_block: Anchored strictly between 55% and 90% from the top edge, centered horizontally.

composition.depth_logic: Literal flat collage stacking. Text must look physically pressed into the paper.

typography.letterform_character: Authentic 1960s vintage newspaper print, Chinese Mingti (Serif) or Heiti (Gothic) with faded toner and ink bleed

hierarchy.alignment: Strictly Flush-Left to the 10% vertical axis
hierarchy.bounding_box: Must not exceed 10% of the canvas height

hierarchy.alignment: Strictly Flush-Left to the 10% vertical axis, ragged-right
hierarchy.paragraph_spacing: Fixed, generous line height (leading) between each bullet point to maintain structural consistency
hierarchy.bounding_box: Confined to a fixed block between 22% and 45% height

text_constraints: CRITICAL: Maintain the exact same starting X and Y coordinates for text across all generations
Ensure bullet points wrap neatly without breaking the left margin

visual_direction.lighting: Zero global 3D shading. Collage cutouts have inconsistent physical lighting.
visual_direction.material_textures: Tactile handmade paper grain, faded toner ink, plaster, concrete.

do: Lock the layout coordinates strictly to the defined percentages
Ensure the visual metaphor stays entirely within its bounding box in the lower half
avoid: Floating or varying text starting positions
Text crossing the 50% vertical midline into the bottom half
